class.name: SpineRenderWorld3D
class.brief_description: Collects streamed 3D Spine slot geometry into ordered batched mesh runs.
class.description: [code]SpineRenderWorld3D[/code] is the first backend for an ordered skeletal render stream. Descendant [code]SpineSprite3D[/code] nodes with [code]render_backend[/code] set to [code]Stream World[/code], or to [code]Auto Stream World[/code] while parented under this world, keep their normal skeleton, animation, bone, slot, and collision logic, but submit their visible slots as lightweight render parts to this world. The world sorts those parts by render plane, world order, sprite stream order, collector object index, and slot order, then merges consecutive parts that share the same canonical stream material into larger [code]ArrayMesh[/code] surfaces. Generated and runtime override materials are cached by the render world so identical streamed sprites can share material instances inside the same render-cell. Nested [code]SpineRenderWorld3D[/code] descendants stop recursive collection to avoid submitting the same sprite into parent and child worlds. New [code]SpineSprite3D[/code] nodes default to [code]Auto Stream World[/code]. Without a [code]SpineRenderWorld3D[/code] ancestor they fall back to their local reference mesh; under a render world they automatically use the streamed batched path. This backend is still a GDExtension-level dynamic mesh path. It reduces per-slot surface churn and preserves ordered transparency barriers inside one render world, but it is not a renderer-core custom pass or GPU bone palette implementation.

method.name: render_now
method.description: Immediately collects descendant stream-enabled [code]SpineSprite3D[/code] nodes, including [code]Auto Stream World[/code] sprites under this world, and rebuilds the batched meshes.

members.member: When enabled, the world collects and rebuilds once per process frame.
